New Features
Create your own survivor before starting a new Survival Run.
Your customization now carries over into the actual game.
Live 3D character preview while customizing.
Rotate and inspect your survivor before starting.
👕 Clothing Categories

Choose from different styles, including:

🚔 Police Clothing
🪖 Military Clothing
👕 Civilian Clothing

Mix and match clothing pieces such as:

Jackets
Shirts
Pants
Shoes & Boots
Hats & Helmets
Backpacks
Accessories
✨ Quality of Life
Randomize your survivor with one click.
Reset your appearance at any time.
Your outfit is saved and will be remembered the next time you play.
Clean and improved customization interface.
